claims: Debt relief often requires more than $7,500 in debt.
Debt relief typically works within 24-48 months.
Debt relief eligibility usually requires at least $7,500 to $10,000 in unsecured debt.
Unsecured debt includes credit cards, personal loans, medical bills.
Fees are typically charged only after a settlement is successful.
For-profit debt settlement companies usually charge fees.
For-profit debt settlement companies often charge a percentage of the debt as fees.
Creditors are not required to settle.
Creditors may still sue for the balance.
Debt forgiven over $600 might be considered taxable income by the IRS.
Debt relief eligibility requires the ability to make consistent monthly deposits into a dedicated account.
Debt settlement involves negotiating with creditors to pay less than the full amount owed.
A Debt Management Plan (DMP) involves a counselor working with creditors to reduce interest rates and fees.
A Debt Management Plan (DMP) is often managed through a non-profit credit counseling agency.
Debt consolidation loans combine multiple debts into one loan.
Debt consolidation loans often have a lower interest rate.
Bankruptcy is a legal process under Chapter 7 or Chapter 13.
Chapter 7 or 13 bankruptcy can discharge debts or create a repayment plan.
